payload.name: Drag
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Drag is a shared inbox for Gmail teams. The addresses everyone answers, like support@, sales@ and info@, become boards the whole team works together, with assignment, labels, a help center, WhatsApp and response-time reporting. It runs inside Gmail and Google Workspace, so nobody has to learn a new inbox.

Connect Drag to ChatGPT and you can run that team inbox by asking. Triage what arrived overnight, draft a reply grounded in your own help center article, assign a conversation to a teammate, or turn a customer email into a task with a due date.

47 tools across 12 categories, with full read and write access:

Triage: list, search and filter email threads by column, assignee or label, and find what has waited longest for a reply.

Reply: draft and send responses grounded in your own help center articles, and leave internal comments for teammates.

Organize: assign conversations to teammates, add and remove labels and tags, and move threads between columns or boards.

Plan: turn customer emails into task cards with due dates and checklists, and move work across columns as it progresses.

WhatsApp: read conversations and send messages or approved templates alongside email.

Report: first response times, average response time, daily volume and closed-conversation counts.

Setup takes about two minutes: add the plugin, then enter your Drag API key once on a secure connect page. The key never appears in a web address and the connect service stores nothing. ChatGPT inherits your Drag permissions, and every action is attributed to you inside Drag where the whole team can see it. Reading never interrupts you; sending email or WhatsApp always asks first.

Requires a Drag account with API access. Open source, MIT licensed.
payload.longDescription:
Drag是Gmail团队的共享收件箱。所有人处理的邮箱地址，如support@、sales@和info@，会变成团队协作的看板，支持分配任务、添加标签、建立帮助中心、接入WhatsApp及回复时效报告。它直接运行在Gmail和Google Workspace内，无需团队成员学习新的收件箱系统。

将Drag连接至ChatGPT后，可通过提问管理团队收件箱。您可分类处理夜间积累的邮件、基于自有帮助中心文章起草回复、将对话分配给同事，或通过设定截止日期将客户邮件转为任务。

涵盖12个类别的47个工具，均提供完整的读写权限：

分类处理：通过栏目、负责人或标签筛选、搜索邮件线程，并查看等待回复时间最长的邮件。

回复管理：基于自有帮助中心文章起草并发送回复，并为同事留下内部评论。

整理优化：将对话分配给同事、添加/移除标签和标记，并在不同栏目或看板间移动邮件线程。

计划管理：将客户邮件转化为带截止日期和待办清单的任务卡片，并在工作推进时跨栏目移动任务。

WhatsApp：通过电子邮件同时阅读对话内容并发送消息或已批准的模板。

报告内容包括：首次响应时间、平均响应时间、每日消息量及已关闭对话数量。

设置过程约需两分钟：添加插件后，前往安全连接页面输入您的Drag API密钥。密钥永远不会出现在网址中，连接服务不会存储任何内容。ChatGPT将继承您的Drag权限，所有操作在Drag内都会标记为您的身份，团队成员均可查看。阅读操作不会打扰您；发送电子邮件或WhatsApp时总会先询问您。

需要拥有API访问权限的Drag账户。开源软件，采用MIT协议许可。

payload.name: camelBots
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
camelBots turns a description into a running Discord bot. Say what your bot should do, for example roll dice for game night, welcome new members or run a trivia round, and camel-builder, camelBots' builder, writes its code, tries it in a private test channel and saves it. Ask for changes in plain words; when you are happy, publish it and add it to your server with one link that opens Discord's own screen. camelBots hosts the bot for you: there is nothing to install or keep running.

It is for community owners, moderators and anyone who wants a custom bot without writing or hosting code.

The app acts only on the camelBots account you sign in with, and only on its bots. A bot stays a draft until you publish it, and adding it to a server always happens on Discord's screen, where you pick a server you manage. It never asks for Discord bot tokens or other credentials in the conversation: camelBots asks for them on its own pages. Deleting a bot is done in camelBots itself.
payload.longDescription:
camelBots能将描述转化为运行中的Discord机器人。描述你的机器人应执行的任务，例如为游戏之夜掷骰子、欢迎新成员或开展问答环节，camel-builder（camelBots的构建工具）会编写代码，在私有测试频道中进行测试并保存。用自然语言提出修改需求；确认无误后通过链接发布，并使用该链接直接打开Discord内置界面添加至你的服务器。camelBots会为你托管机器人：无需安装或维护任何内容。

适用于社区管理员、版主以及希望拥有定制机器人但无需编写或托管代码的用户。

该应用仅操作你登录的camelBots账户及其对应的机器人。机器人在发布前始终为草稿状态，添加至服务器的操作始终在Discord界面完成，需从你管理的服务器中选择。它不会在对话中请求Discord机器人令牌或其他凭证：camelBots会在其独立页面中获取这些信息。删除机器人需在camelBots平台内操作。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create a Discord bot from a description, Change a bot by describing what you want, List your bots and see where they are installed, Publish a bot, Get the link that adds a bot to your server

payload.name: Artil
payload.description: 为您的AI提供邮箱和电话
payload.summaryOriginal: Email and phone for your AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Artil gives ChatGPT its own identity with email address and phone number, separate from yours. Ask ChatGPT to email a restaurant about a booking, follow up with a supplier, or handle messages from a service you're signing up for. It can receive replies, read verification emails, and continue conversations without using your personal email.

Create an Agent Account in Artil and connect it to ChatGPT, giving your assistant a persistent identity to communicate with people and services on its own behalf. Use Artil in everyday ChatGPT chats, ChatGPT Work, or with dots to let your assistant communicate beyond ChatGPT.

Artil also connects ChatGPT to other AI agents in your company. Give each agent an Artil account and ChatGPT can contact it directly via URL, by email, or by text. For example, ask ChatGPT to request a monthly report from your sales agent and have that agent email the results to your team. Each agent keeps working wherever it already runs, with its own identity and communication channels.
payload.longDescription:
Artil为ChatGPT赋予独立的邮箱地址和电话号码，与您的个人信息分开。
可以让ChatGPT代您向餐厅发送预订邮件，跟进供应商或处理注册服务的沟通。
它能够接收回复、阅读验证邮件，并在不使用您个人邮箱的情况下持续对话。

在Artil中创建代理账户并连接至ChatGPT，为您的助手赋予持久身份，使其能够以独立身份与人员和服务进行沟通。
可在日常ChatGPT对话、ChatGPT工作场景中，或通过dots功能让助手突破ChatGPT限制进行沟通。

Artil还可将ChatGPT与公司内部的其他AI代理相连接。
为每个代理分配Artil账户后，ChatGPT可通过网址、邮件或短信直接与其联系。
例如，让ChatGPT向销售代理请求月度报告，并由该代理将结果邮件发送至您的团队。
每个代理仍可在原有运行环境中持续工作，保持独立身份和通信渠道。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Send email and texts, Read its inbox, Wait for replies

payload.name: FiraPhone
payload.description: 通过浏览器拨打语音电话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your existing FiraPhone account to call supported landlines and mobile phones inside ChatGPT. Check the destination rate first, choose a maximum call length, then start the call yourself in the dialler. Includes microphone testing, speaker volume, mute, a touch-tone keypad and hang-up. See your balance and the final provider-confirmed charge. Requires an existing account with calling credit and a browser with microphone access. Emergency calls are not supported. No call recording, subscriptions or credit purchases in the plugin.
payload.longDescription: 使用现有FiraPhone账户在ChatGPT内部拨打支持的固话和手机。首先检查目的地费率，选择最大通话时长，然后在拨号器中自行发起通话。包含麦克风测试、扬声器音量调节、静音、拨号键盘和挂断功能。可查看账户余额及最终由供应商确认的费用。需要已开通通话信用额度的账户，以及支持麦克风访问的浏览器。不支持紧急呼叫，插件中不提供通话录音、订阅或信用额度购买功能。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check your FiraPhone calling balance, Check a phone number’s rate before calling, Make browser calls with microphone and audio controls, Read the confirmed call outcome and charge

payload.name: Rep
payload.description: 与经过认证的高管建立联系
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rep is an invitation-only social network for verified company executives in Japan. Connecting your Rep account lets ChatGPT work with the network you already belong to.

What you can do:
- Read the Rep board, where members post what they are looking for and what they can offer, and the timeline, where members share updates.
- Browse anonymous discussion threads, member profiles, and recently joined members.
- Find executives who match a need such as hiring, sales, partnerships, vendors, fundraising, or advice, with a short reason for each candidate.
- Publish a board post, timeline post, thread, or comment. These are visible to other Rep members.
- Save drafts to the approval queue in the Rep app. Drafts are not published until you approve them in the app.
- Send an introduction request to an executive. The recipient decides in the Rep app whether to connect.

Rep only accesses data available to your connected account. A Rep membership is required.
payload.longDescription:
Rep是面向日本经认证公司高管的邀请制社交网络。连接您的Rep账户后，ChatGPT即可与您所属的网络进行协作。

您可以：
- 浏览Rep动态板（成员发布需求与资源信息）和时间线（成员分享更新动态）
- 查看匿名讨论帖、成员资料及近期加入成员
- 根据招聘、销售、合作、供应商、融资或咨询等需求，查找匹配的高管，并附简要推荐理由
- 发布动态板帖文、时间线帖文、讨论帖或评论
（以上内容对其他Rep成员可见）
- 将草稿保存至Rep应用的审批队列
- 在应用中审批通过后才会发布草稿
- 向高管发送介绍请求
接收方将在Rep应用中决定是否建立连接。

Rep仅访问您已连接账户的数据。需拥有Rep会员资格。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find executives, Read the board and timeline, Publish posts, Save drafts for approval, Request introductions

payload.name: Send & Retain Emails
payload.description: 电子邮件模板与自动化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send & Retain is an email automation service. It creates, sends and tracks a company's transactional and marketing email — order confirmations, welcome emails, abandoned-cart reminders, win-back campaigns — and this plugin lets you run all of it from a conversation: the templates, the automations that send them, the contacts they go to, and the sending setup behind them.

Stand up a company's programme from its business type: a brand kit, starter templates and the matching automations (welcome, abandoned cart, order updates, win-back), created paused. Write and revise react.email templates in the company's own brand and voice, render them with sample data, and publish when they are right. Design event-triggered automations with delays, send windows, branches and A/B variants, preview every email in an automation, and check what would block it before it goes live. Manage contacts, attributes and segments, read delivery and engagement metrics by template and by day, search the message log, and triage bounces and complaints.

Built for founders, marketers and agencies running email for one company or a portfolio of them.

Safety by design: there is no bulk send. Every message has one recipient, and mail reaches many people only through an automation a person explicitly enabled. Automations are always created paused, and enabling one is a separate, confirmed step. Each company has a send kill switch and an optional daily cap. Bounces and complaints suppress addresses automatically, and complaint suppressions can never be removed. Provider API keys are entered only on the Send & Retain settings page, never in chat.

Limitations: email only (no SMS, push or social posting). Sending needs a connected provider or platform sending and a verified domain, which a person sets up once per company. Connecting requires a Send & Retain account.
payload.longDescription:
Send & Retain 是一项电子邮件自动化服务，可创建、发送并跟踪企业的交易类和营销类邮件——包括订单确认邮件、欢迎邮件、购物车遗弃提醒、客户召回活动——此插件可让你通过对话界面完成全部操作：模板管理、发送模板的自动化流程、目标联系人列表，以及背后的发送设置。

根据企业类型快速搭建邮件计划：品牌资料包、基础模板以及匹配的自动化流程（欢迎邮件、购物车遗弃提醒、订单更新、客户召回），所有流程初始状态均为暂停。可在企业自有品牌风格和语气下编写与修改 react.email 模板，使用示例数据预览效果，确认无误后发布。通过延迟、发送时段、分支逻辑和 A/B 测试变体设计事件触发自动化流程，预览自动化中的每封邮件，并在上线前检查可能阻塞发送的因素。管理联系人、属性和分组，按模板和日期查看送达与互动数据，搜索邮件日志，处理退信和投诉。

专为创始人、营销人员和代理机构设计，适用于单个企业或多个企业的邮件运营。

设计安全：不支持群发功能。每封邮件仅有一个收件人，邮件通过用户明确启用的自动化流程触达多人。所有自动化流程初始状态均为暂停，启用需单独确认。每个企业配备发送紧急关闭开关，并可设置每日发送上限。退信和投诉会自动屏蔽对应地址，投诉屏蔽记录无法解除。供应商 API 密钥仅在 Send & Retain 设置页面输入，不会通过聊天窗口传递。

限制条件：仅支持电子邮件（不支持短信、推送或社交媒体发布）。发送邮件需要连接供应商或平台进行发送，并需验证企业域名，每家企业需一次性完成设置。连接操作需要 Send & Retain 账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Brand kit and starter programme per company, Author, render and publish react.email templates, Event-triggered automations, created paused, Contacts, attributes and segments, Delivery and engagement metrics, Message log and deliverability triage, Sending setup: provider, domain, senders, API keys

payload.name: ChatRook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover public ChatRook video rooms directly in ChatGPT. Search by room title or slug, check recent participant counts, and get a link to open a room on ChatRook. Check a specific public room before opening it. No login is needed for public discovery. Joining happens on ChatRook and may require signing in or meeting access checks. Room names are user-generated, and recent presence does not guarantee a live conversation. This connector does not read private rooms, messages or recordings, create meetings, contact anyone, start calls, or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中直接发现ChatRook公共视频房间。通过房间标题或别名搜索，查看最近参与人数并获取ChatRook的房间链接。可在打开房间前查看特定公共房间信息。公共发现功能无需登录。加入操作在ChatRook平台进行，可能需要登录或通过会议访问验证。房间名称由用户生成，近期活跃记录不保证存在实时对话。该连接器不会读取私有房间/消息/录音，无法创建会议、联系任何人、发起通话或处理支付。

payload.name: Sendblue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn customer conversations into sales with iMessage, RCS, and SMS. Send messages and read replies from your Sendblue workspace directly in ChatGPT. Get started with iMessage without A2P 10DLC approval.

Sendblue customers report 2x+ response rates and $2B+ in sales using the service.

Follow up with leads, pick up recent conversations, and check message delivery without leaving your chat. Ask Sendblue to find your sending numbers, show a contact’s recent messages, send a personal follow-up, or summarize your recent messaging performance.

Connect an existing Sendblue account, choose your workspace, and approve the permissions you want to share. Messages use Sendblue’s available iMessage, RCS, and SMS routing. You can disconnect at any time from Sendblue Connected Apps.
payload.longDescription:
通过iMessage、RCS和短信将客户对话转化为销售机会。
可在ChatGPT中直接从Sendblue工作区发送消息并阅读回复。
无需A2P 10DLC批准即可开始使用iMessage。

Sendblue客户使用该服务后报告回复率提升2倍以上，销售额达200多亿美元。

无需离开聊天界面即可跟进潜在客户、查看最近对话并检查消息传递情况。
可要求Sendblue查找您的发送号码、展示联系人最近的对话、发送个性化跟进消息或总结近期沟通表现。

连接现有Sendblue账户，选择您的工作区，并批准共享的权限。
消息将使用Sendblue提供的iMessage、RCS和短信路由功能。
可随时通过Sendblue Connected Apps断开连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read messages, Send messages, Check delivery status, Evaluate messaging health

payload.name: Lemma Telepath
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lemma Telepath connects your Telegram Business account to ChatGPT so your assistant can work with your own business conversations. Ask it to summarise a thread, find the message where a price or a deadline was agreed, read a screenshot a client sent, listen to a voice message as text, or draft and send a reply as you.

It is built on the official Telegram Business API: you add our bot as your Business chatbot in Telegram and grant it the rights you choose, so there is no MTProto user session and nothing is scraped. From that moment your 1:1 business messages are archived into an account that is yours alone — one isolated database per account, full-text searchable, including the text inside attachments and transcripts of voice and round-video messages.

You stay in control of what the assistant may do. Every capability — replies, media, notes, group archiving — is a switch you can turn off at any time from the bot, and sending is surfaced for your confirmation before anything reaches another person. You can erase everything you have stored with a single command.

Telepath is not end-to-end encrypted and we say so plainly: searching and transcribing require our servers to read your messages. Data is encrypted at rest with full-disk encryption, each account is physically isolated, and voice transcription is opt-in, disclosing the processor it uses before you turn it on. If you need a guarantee that no operator can ever read your data, the same connector can be self-hosted on your own machine.
payload.longDescription:
Lemma Telepath将您的Telegram商业账户连接至ChatGPT，让您的助手能够处理专属的业务对话。可让它总结对话线程、查找价格或截止日期达成的消息、查看客户发送的截图、将语音消息转为文字，或代为起草并发送回复。

它基于官方Telegram商业API开发：您可在Telegram中将我们的机器人添加为商业聊天机器人并授予所需权限，无需MTProto用户会话，也不会抓取任何数据。从此时起，您的1对1业务消息将归档至专属账户——每个账户拥有独立数据库，支持全文搜索，包含附件内文本及语音和视频消息的转录内容。

您始终掌握对助手操作的控制权。所有功能——回复、媒体处理、笔记记录、群组归档——都是可随时在机器人中关闭的开关，任何内容发送前都需要您确认。您可通过一条指令清除所有存储数据。

Telepath并非端到端加密，我们明确说明这一点：搜索和转录功能需要我们的服务器读取您的消息。数据以全盘加密方式存储，每个账户物理隔离，语音转录功能需用户主动开启，并会在启用前披露所用处理器。如需确保无任何操作员能读取您的数据，同一连接工具可自行托管在您的设备上。

payload.name: Mail Merge for Gmail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Send personalized email campaigns from Gmail, manage contacts and templates, and review campaign activity and analytics. Prepare each campaign with a preview and confirm before sending.
payload.longDescription: 通过Gmail发送个性化电子邮件活动，管理联系人和模板，并查看活动概览与分析数据。通过预览准备每场活动并在发送前确认。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Kadenzo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kadenzo is a social media scheduler. Connect your Kadenzo account and ChatGPT can plan and schedule posts to the accounts you have linked in Kadenzo (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, YouTube, Mastodon and Telegram), with per-platform text, threads and media links.

Ask it to draft a post and schedule it for Tuesday at 9am, check whether a post fits each network's limits before it goes out, move or cancel something in your queue, see how your recent posts performed, find your best times to post from your own engagement history, or catch up on who is mentioning your brand.

Kadenzo always schedules for a future time and never publishes instantly, and ChatGPT asks you to confirm before anything is scheduled, changed or cancelled. You need a Kadenzo account with at least one social account connected. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under Settings → API keys in Kadenzo.
payload.longDescription:
Kadenzo是一款社交媒体调度工具，连接您的Kadenzo账户后，ChatGPT可以为您计划并安排已连接账户（Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、LinkedIn、X、Threads、Bluesky、Pinterest、YouTube、Mastodon和Telegram）的帖子，支持各平台的文字、话题和媒体链接

您可以让它起草一篇帖子并安排在周二上午9点发布，发布前检查帖子是否符合各网络的限制，调整或取消队列中的内容，查看近期帖子的表现，根据自己的互动历史找到最佳发布时间，或了解哪些人正在提及您的品牌

Kadenzo始终安排未来时间发布，从不立即推送，且在任何内容被安排、修改或取消前会向您确认。您需要拥有已连接至少一个社交账户的Kadenzo账户，可在Kadenzo的设置→API密钥中随时断开ChatGPT连接

payload.name: Missive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and read conversations across your connected Missive accounts, find contacts and team inboxes, draft and send messages, and organize conversations with labels. You can also view and manage connected calendar events. Access follows your Missive account permissions, organization settings, and granted OAuth scopes.
payload.longDescription: 在您的连接的Missive账户中搜索并阅读对话，查找联系人和团队邮箱，起草并发送消息，通过标签整理对话。您还可以查看和管理连接的日历事件。访问权限遵循您的Missive账户权限、组织设置和授予的OAuth范围。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: DataFlows SMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send and manage business SMS from your DataFlows account, in plain language.

Features
• Send SMS to up to 10 numbers at once, from your own sender ID or number
• Send campaigns to your DataFlows contact groups
• Preview before you send: recipients, SMS parts, credits needed, and warnings for emoji, long messages, a missing opt-out line or blocked words
• Schedule messages for later, see what is scheduled, and cancel anything before it sends
• Check the delivery status of every message you sent
• Read replies from the people you messaged
• Campaign results: delivered, failed with the reason, and pending
• Usage summary: messages sent, credits used, delivery rate and top senders
• Your credit balance and available senders at a glance

Built-in safeguards
• Every send is confirmed with you before it goes out
• A group send must match the recipient count you previewed
• The same sender ID registration, opt-out and blocklist rules as the DataFlows dashboard

Privacy
The connection only sees messages sent through it, not messages from your DataFlows dashboard or other integrations. It shows contact group names and sizes, never the contacts themselves.

Requires a DataFlows account (sms.dataflows.com.au).
payload.longDescription:
通过您的DataFlows账户以自然语言发送和管理业务短信。

功能
• 一次最多向10个号码发送短信，使用您自己的发件人ID或号码
• 向您的DataFlows联系人分组发送活动
• 发送前预览：收件人信息、短信内容片段、所需信用额度，以及表情符号、长消息、缺少退订说明或被禁词汇的警告
• 定时发送消息，查看已安排内容，并在发送前取消任何消息
• 查看每条已发送消息的送达状态
• 查阅您发送消息对象的回复
• 活动结果：已送达、失败原因及待处理状态
• 使用统计：发送短信数、消耗信用额度、送达率及最高发送量用户
• 一目了然的信用额度及可用发件人列表

内置安全机制
• 每次发送前都会获得您的确认
• 群发消息的收件人数量必须与预览一致
• 使用与DataFlows仪表盘相同的发件人ID注册规则、退订机制和黑名单规则

隐私保护
该连接仅查看通过它的消息，不包含您DataFlows仪表盘或其他集成渠道的消息。
显示联系人分组名称和规模，永不显示具体联系人信息。

需要DataFlows账户（sms.dataflows.com.au）。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Send SMS, Group campaigns, Scheduled messages, Cost previews, Delivery reports, Usage summaries

payload.name: TellTell
payload.description: 管理团队电子邮件列表
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage the people and memberships behind your team’s group email lists. TellTell provides dedicated group email addresses for teams, schools, clubs, and organizations, so members can communicate from their usual email inboxes.

Connect your TellTell Admin account to find and update people, see which groups they belong to, organize overlapping teams and groups, manage custom fields and tags, and preview roster imports or membership changes before applying them.

You choose the connected account and permissions. Bulk editing starts disabled and requires an Admin to enable it. Membership changes may send configured welcome emails, and some person or settings changes may trigger automatic-photo lookups.

This plugin manages your TellTell directory and groups. It does not read your Gmail or Outlook inbox, send standalone emails, manage billing, or grant account-user access.
payload.longDescription:
管理团队群组邮件列表中的成员信息。
TellTell为团队、学校、俱乐部和组织提供专用群组电子邮件地址，让成员能够通过常规电子邮件收件箱进行沟通。

将您的TellTell管理员账户进行连接，可查找并更新人员信息，查看其所属群组，整理重叠的团队和群组，管理自定义字段和标签，并在应用前预览人员名单导入或会员变更。

您可自行设置连接账户和权限。
批量编辑功能默认关闭，需管理员手动启用。
会员变更可能触发配置的欢迎邮件，部分人员信息或设置变更可能激活自动照片检索。

此插件用于管理您的TellTell通讯录和群组。
它不会读取您的Gmail或Outlook收件箱，不会独立发送邮件，不处理账单管理，也不提供账户用户访问权限。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Manage group email lists, Manage people and memberships, Preview roster changes

payload.name: Realtime Avatar
payload.description: 实时AI虚拟形象视频通话功能
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Realtime Avatar (RTA) brings live, interactive AI avatar video conversations to ChatGPT. Talk by voice or text, choose a conversation topic, and control your session from a single view. Powered by realtimeavatar.ai.
payload.longDescription:
Realtime Avatar（RTA）将实时互动的AI虚拟形象视频对话功能带入ChatGPT。
通过语音或文字交谈，选择对话主题，并通过单一视图控制您的会话。
由realtimeavatar.ai提供支持。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find the available AI avatar, Set up an avatar conversation with an optional topic, Start and end a live avatar video call, Read the current session status, Return a session-completion message after an explicit user action

payload.name: teem
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: teem is customer support and feedback software for product teams. It gives a team one inbox for customer chat, a public board where customers request and vote on features, a changelog, and a help center. With this plugin, a team member can ask ChatGPT who is waiting for a reply, what customers ask for most, and what shipped, then have it draft replies, changelog entries and help articles from that data. Replies, status changes and publishing happen only after the team member approves them. When a request ships, teem emails every customer who voted for it.
payload.longDescription: teem 是面向产品团队的客户支持与反馈软件。它为团队提供统一的客户聊天邮箱、一个客户可请求并投票选择功能的公共看板、更新日志和帮助中心。通过此插件，团队成员可以向ChatGPT询问哪些客户等待回复、客户最常请求什么以及哪些功能已发布，然后根据这些数据生成回复、更新日志条目和帮助文章。回复、状态更改和发布仅在团队成员批准后进行。当请求被发布时，teem 会向所有投票支持该请求的客户发送邮件。

payload.name: Consensus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Consensus is the go-to MCP for academic research. Connect directly to 220M+ peer-reviewed papers to search, synthesize, and build structured research outputs from within your conversation.

Run literature reviews, build boolean search strategies, generate bibliographies, identify research gaps, and draft cited content — grounded in studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and ArXiv. Pre-built workflows handle complex tasks in minutes: systematic reviews, curriculum reading lists, grant research with novelty analysis, and clinical evidence synthesis.

Built for researchers, students, faculty, and clinicians across biomedical, social science, STEM, and all academic disciplines.
payload.longDescription:
Consensus 是学术研究的首选 MCP。直接连接至 2.2 亿+ 篇同行评审论文，在对话中搜索、整合并构建结构化研究输出。

执行文献综述、构建布尔搜索策略、生成参考文献列表、识别研究空白并撰写引用内容——基于 PubMed、Semantic Scholar 和 ArXiv 的研究。预设工作流程可在数分钟内完成复杂任务：系统综述、课程阅读清单、包含新颖性分析的资助研究以及临床证据整合。

专为生物医学、社会科学、STEM（科学、技术、工程、数学）及所有学术领域的研究人员、学生、教职员工和临床医生打造。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search research papers, Read paper details

payload.name: Explain Video Generator
payload.description: 免费 AI 讲解视频制作工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn anything into a narrated explainer video, without leaving ChatGPT. Free to start, no login required.

Give it a topic, a document, a webpage, a codebase or a product brief, and Explain turns it into a video in your language — with voiceover, diagrams, animations and images, plus real code walkthroughs when you need them. 

Add your own images and screenshots and they go straight in. Share with a link or download the video file.

How you can use Explain:

* Onboard new employees without filming a thing
* Study a difficult subject before an exam, in the language you think in
* Walk your team through a pull request or codebase
* Show customers how your product works, using your own screenshots
* Make the same video in 40+ languages from a single document
* Start your class with a 3-minute lesson opener built from the textbook chapter
* Paste any web link to get a narrated video explanation
* Turn a long ChatGPT conversation into a video you can rewatch or share
* Create a bedtime story for your child

Want to make it your own? Keep editing on our platform, then combine your explainers into full courses and playlists.

Powered by Scrimba, a learning platform with over 2 million users.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可将任何内容转换为配有旁白的讲解视频。免费开始，无需登录。

提供一个主题、文档、网页、代码库或产品简介，Explain 就会用你的语言将其制作成视频，包含配音、图表、动画和图像；需要时还可以逐步讲解真实代码。

添加自己的图像和屏幕截图，它们会直接加入视频。通过链接分享或下载视频文件。

Explain 的用途：

* 无需拍摄即可为新员工提供入职培训
* 用你熟悉的语言，在考试前学习难懂的主题
* 向团队讲解拉取请求或代码库
* 使用自己的屏幕截图向客户展示产品的工作方式
* 根据一份文档制作 40 多种语言版本的同一视频
* 将教材章节制作成 3 分钟课程开场内容
* 粘贴任意网页链接，生成带旁白的视频讲解
* 将冗长的 ChatGPT 对话转成可重看或分享的视频
* 为孩子创作睡前故事

想进一步定制？可在我们的平台继续编辑，并将多个讲解视频组合成完整课程和播放列表。

由 Scrimba 提供支持，这是一个拥有超过 200 万用户的学习平台。

payload.name: Acumen by Talarion
payload.description: 让 AI 掌握最新信息
payload.summaryOriginal: Keep your AI up to date.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Talarion keeps AI current. Frontier models don't know about recent events, and web search can't answer questions LLMs don't know to ask. Talarion proactively tells your AI what it's missing before it starts researching to prevent critical omissions and judgement errors. Install the MCP to make sure your AI assistant knows what it would otherwise be missing.
payload.longDescription: Talarion 让 AI 保持与时俱进。前沿模型不了解近期事件，网页搜索也无法回答 LLM 不知道该问的问题。Talarion 在 AI 开始研究前主动告知其缺失的信息，避免关键遗漏和判断错误。安装 MCP，确保你的 AI 助手知道原本会遗漏的内容。

payload.name: SciSpace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SciSpace for ChatGPT supports the core tasks of research: discovery, triage, and synthesis.

Use it to search for academic papers and review them in a customizable table with metadata and links. Add structured columns - abstract, summary, methods, results, conclusions - to quickly assess relevance and quality. Then use the collected list as the basis for literature review notes, thematic synthesis, and targeted follow-up searches.

Get started with prompts like: 
1.  "SciSpace Find papers on impact of nanoplastics on gut health"
2. "SciSpace How does climate change impact biodiversity?"
payload.longDescription:
SciSpace for ChatGPT 支持研究的核心任务：发现、筛选和综合。

使用它搜索学术论文，并在可自定义的表格中通过元数据和链接进行审阅。添加结构化列——摘要、概要、方法、结果、结论——以便快速评估相关性和质量。随后可将收集的列表用于撰写文献综述笔记、主题综合和有针对性的后续搜索。

可以尝试以下提示：
1. “SciSpace 查找有关纳米塑料对肠道健康影响的论文”
2. “SciSpace 气候变化如何影响生物多样性？”

payload.name: Scite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: scite helps users search and read scientific papers, inspect citation context and citation graphs, format bibliographies, record citation decisions, and organize papers and notes in Collections through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: scite 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索和阅读科学论文、查看引用上下文和引用关系图、格式化参考书目、记录引用决策，并在 Collections 中整理论文和笔记。

payload.name: Quizlet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Using the Quizlet app in ChatGPT, you can instantly create flashcards from any prompt or file. Just ask for a set on any topic, upload your notes, or describe what you need and we'll handle the formatting and generation for you. No more copying, pasting, or switching tabs. Create, customize, and study all from one place. Whether you're prepping for an exam or building a set between classes, Quizlet in ChatGPT helps you skip the busywork and stay focused on learning.
payload.longDescription: 使用 ChatGPT 中的 Quizlet 应用，你可以根据任何提示或文件即时创建抽认卡。只需提出任何主题的抽认卡需求、上传笔记或描述你的需要，我们就会为你处理格式和生成。无需再复制、粘贴或切换标签页。在一个地方即可创建、自定义并学习。无论你是在准备考试，还是课间想创建一组卡片，ChatGPT 中的 Quizlet 都能帮你省去繁琐工作，专注学习。

payload.name: Wolfram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Wolfram MCP Server transforms your AI environment into a rigorous computational powerhouse. By integrating Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, this server provides access to curated data and sophisticated algorithms. When a user submits a query, the LLM works with Wolfram to convert it into Wolfram Language for precise evaluation, and these exact results are incorporated into the response provided by the LLM.

Whether you are solving complex differential equations, analyzing chemical structures or querying real-time socioeconomic data, the MCP Server ensures your AI has the "computational brain" necessary to deliver verified, high-level technical results that can be trusted.
payload.longDescription:
Wolfram MCP Server 将你的 AI 环境变成严谨的计算平台。它集成 Wolfram Language 和 Wolfram|Alpha，可访问精选数据与复杂算法。用户提交问题后，LLM 会与 Wolfram 协作，将问题转换为 Wolfram Language 并进行精确计算，再将准确结果纳入回复。

无论是求解复杂微分方程、分析化学结构，还是查询实时社会经济数据，MCP Server 都能为 AI 提供所需的“计算大脑”，从而给出经过验证、值得信赖的高水平技术结果。
